title: metadata-protocol: a save naming a package beside an existing package-less row of the item mints a second row, and the read naming no package keeps serving the unbound one (S6, reachable through today's doors)
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a reproducible defect**. `reach:` the protocol save and read doors that `PUT` and `GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` call. Measured over a row-keeping stub engine at PR #23290's head (`b546c5ff2`, #23165's fix), through the protocol doors; the HTTP route itself was not driven for this sequence. Dev report `6148282605` on #23165, out-of-scope finding 1. #23165's card names this shape "S6", and its "Existing rows" line excludes it: *"If one is measured served wrongly, that measurement is its own card."* This is that card. Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/metadata-protocol`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at #23165's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (the sequence, at the protocol doors)

1. A package-less save of an item with NO package binding writes the package-unbound row (`package_id` null).
2. A save of the same item naming a package then writes a second row beside it. The stored rows are now `[null 'unbound']` and `[com.qa.lanebapp 'pkg']`, with the unbound row first.
3. The read naming no package serves `'unbound'`, and the read naming the package serves `'pkg'`.
4. A package-less save then resolves the one bound package (#23165's option B) and writes the package row ("Saved app … (env-wide, package=com.qa.lanebapp, state=active)"). The read naming no package still serves `'unbound'`, while the list serves the new body.
5. A package-less delete removes the package row, and its receipt says the package-less row remains.

So once a package-scoped save lands beside an existing package-less row, the read naming no package (ADR-0048 §3.3, first match) and the save naming no package address different rows.

## Governing text

- ADR-0070 TL;DR 1: the package-less state "stops being an authoring destination; it remains only as a read-side rehydration detail and a migration source".
- ADR-0048 §3.3: a context-free read is best-effort and returns the first match.

## Wanted

The lane decides which of these fits ADR-0070, and the PR states it:
- the save naming a package refuses to mint a row beside an unbound row of the same item;
- or it adopts that row;
- or the read naming no package resolves the same address the save does.

Pins: the sequence above, with each step's read agreeing with the save's address.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `package-scoped save beside package-less row mints second row read naming no package serves unbound row` → 7 hits. #23165 (its parent, which excludes this shape), #22057, #21817 and #21761 are closed siblings on other read and lock paths. None is this.

Dedupe words: package-scoped save beside package-less row; second row unbound first; read naming no package serves unbound; S6 save address read address disagree.
